IT-i
INSTRUCTIONS
TOTENDERERS
GENERALITIES
1.

Introduction

1.1

The purpose of these Instructions is provided the Tenderers with the necessary information and
instructions to enable them to prepare and submit their Tenders in a coordinated manner and to
establish the procedure to be followed up to the time when the Contract is awarded.
Deevar Developers (Pvt) is establishing their "Zameen Opal Project" on their Site at Plot # 16 Land
Breez Society Raiwind Road Lahore over a Plot area of approx. 45,540 Ft2 with a Project covered
area approx. 265,124 Ft2, for which CONSTRUCTION OF ZAMEEN OPAL PHASE -II "Grey Structure
© Labour Rate covered Area Base" is to be started immediately and completed within 540
calendar days.

C

The Project comprises construction of Apartment Building in reinforced concrete in generally 02
basements, ground floor and 1 to 6 stories construction, foundations, retaining/core walls.
boundary wall, mumty, OHWT, UGWT, Main Buildings, Civil works, M.E.P works etc.
The project is to be completed in a strict scheduLe of 540 calendar days for which Covered Area
Rate tenders is being issued.
1.2

Any Tender which does not conform with these Instructions to Tenderers may be rejected.

2.

2.02

Tenderers are also deemed to be in possession of all Standard Specifications, Codes of Practice
and such like documents (ACI, UBC, BSS, BSCP, PS, ASTM, AASHTO etc), current on the date of
opening tenders, which are referred to in the Tender Documents and which are necessary to be
examined in the preparation and submission of the Tender and execution of Works.

3.

Other contractors / Approved Manufacturers
All other contractors that the Tenderer proposes to use, are subject to the acceptance of the
Employer.

IT-2
INSTRUCTIONS
TO TENDERERS
The Contractor shalt be required to obtain prior written approval of the Employer before
employing any other contractor for any or special nature of the Works.
4.

ConfidentiaLity

4.01

ALL Tenderers and other recipients of the Tender Documents (whether or not they submit a
Tender) shall treat all details of the documents as Private and ConlidentiaL and shall neither
disclose nor release the information contained therein for any other use or purpose than that
intended.

4.02

The Tender Documents shall remain the property of the Employer and all unused Tender
Documents shall be returned to the Employer.

5.

ResponsibiLity of Tenderers

5.01

Each Tenderer shall inspect and examine each Site and its surroundings and shall satisfy himself
before submitting his Tender as to the nature of the ground, the hydrological and climatological
conditions, the form and nature of the Site, the quantities and nature of the Work and materials
necessary for the completion of the Works, and the means of access to the Site, the
accommodation he may require, laws, byelaws and regulations, and, in general, shall himself
obtain all necessary information as to risks, contingencies and other circumstances which may
influence or affect his Tender.

5.02

Any neglect or failure on the part of the Tenderer to obtain all relevant information shall not be
considered a reason for extension of time, nor for additional payments in accordance with the
Conditions of Contract, nor shall it relieve him from any risks or liabilities or from the
responsibility of completing and handing over the Works as required.

5.03

The Tenderer shall be entirely responsible for the cost of tendering (if any). The Employer shall
not be responsible for, nor pay for any loss, damage, cost or expense which may be incurred by
any Tenderer.

6.

Clarifications During The Tender Preparation Period

6.01

Should there by any doubt or obscurity as to the meaning of the Tender Documents or as to
anything to be done or not to be done under the Contract the Tenderer must describe in writing
such doubts or obscurity and deliver the same to the Employer at least three days before the
date of tender submission. Any such doubt or obscurity does not allow permission for extension
in submitting the tender.

6.02

A formal Addendum & Corrigendum will be issued as necessary to all Tenderers amending or
explaining the Tender Documents.

6.03

Such Addenda & Corrigenda shall have the status of documents provided for the purpose of
tendering.

TENDER PREPARATION
7.

CompLetion Of The Forms Provided

7.01

Tenderers shalt fill in the blank spaces in the Tender Documents provided for the purpose of
tendering as follows:
Tender and Appendices
Summary of Cost! Bill of Quantities (attached)

7.02

The Tenderers shall enter Covered Area unit rate and fill-in the amounts in Summary of Cost/Bill
of Quantities accordingly. Items against which no rate or price is entered by the Tenderer shall be
deemed to be covered by other rates and prices in the Tender. Unit rates or prices shall be
entered in figures.
The tender is a Covered Area Rate tender. The Covered Area is estimated. The Contractor's rates
shall therefore be valid for quantities required till the completion of Project, and he should
satisfy himself about the sufficiency of rates for any quantity increase /decrease. The quantities
in Summary of Cost/Bill of Quantities can be ±25%, overall, and no limit on variation for
individual items. After award on mutual consent the unit rates may be applied to construction of
other buildings/floors as welL

7.03

The Tenderer shalt be deemed to have satisfied himself before tendering as to the correctness
and sufficiency of his Tender for the Works and of the rates and prices stated by him in the
Summary of Cost/Bill of Quantities which Tender rates and prices shall, except in so far as it is
otherwise provided in the Documents, cover all his obligations under the Contract and all
matters and things necessary for the proper execution, completion and maintenance of the
Works.

8.

Documents To Be Submitted With The Tender

8.01

Authority (Power of Attorney or attested copy thereof) of the signatory authorised to sign the
Tender and the Contract Agreement.

8.02

Preliminary Programme/Construction Schedule giving the out-line time table for completing the
Works and showing the order in which the various sections of the Works are to be constructed
together with the time estimation in each case.

8.03

In order to be considered, Tender must be accompanied by a Tender Security in the form and in
the amount stated in the Appendix A to Tender. The Tender Security shall remain valid for not
less than the period of validity of Tender Security stated in the Appendix A to Tender.
Tender Securities of unsuccessful Tenderers will be returned by the Employer upon award of the
Contract or expiry of the Period of validity of Tender, whichever is earlier.
The Tender Security of the successful Tenderer will be adjusted against the Retention Money
payable by him from his monthLy payments for the work done. Should the successful Tenderer
refuse or fail for any reason to execute the Contract Agreement the entire sum of the Tender
